confirmatory_gate_status.honest_scope_statement: True 2-source unexposed immobilized `E2` confirmation is UNLOCKED: (1) `seyedolmohadesin2025` (47 worms: 32 dev / 15 sealed vault across both sexes, GCaMP6s, 8 chemicals), and (2) `toyoshima2024` (24 recordings / 21 unique worms: 14 dev [11 worms] / 10 sealed vault [10 unseen worms], raw un-centered YC2.60 `YFP/CFP` extracted from `20221118freezed.7z` + `meta/stimulation_timing.xlsx`, explicitly rejecting `normalize1_withoutremove.zip`). `yemini2021` (21 worms) serves strictly for historical dev/regression, `baskoylu2026_copper` (27 worms: 18 dev / 9 vault) serves as a separate freely-moving Cu2+ cross-modality stress test, and `randi2023_atlas` (113 WT + 18 unc-31 atlas + OSF `e2syt` time-series) serves as external mechanistic perturbation validation.

yemini2021.citation: Yemini et al. (Cell 2021) NeuroPAL: A Multicolor Atlas for Whole-Brain Neuronal Identification in C. elegans
yemini2021.stimulus_protocol: 3 chemical stimuli per worm (2-butanone, 2,3-pentanedione, NaCl), 10s ON pulses at t=[60,70)s, [120,130)s, [180,190)s
yemini2021.raw_preprocessing_verified: Extracted strictly `traces` (raw histogram-matched dF/F0 without non-negativity clipping); `norm_traces` explicitly rejected.

seyedolmohadesin2025.citation: Seyedolmohadesin et al. (bioRxiv 2025 / Curr. Biol. 2026) Whole-brain chemosensory responses of both C. elegans sexes
seyedolmohadesin2025.immobilization: 1 mM levamisole in multi-channel microfluidic olfactory chip
seyedolmohadesin2025.stimulus_protocol: 8 chemical stimuli (100mM NaCl, 450mM NaCl, e-2 IAA, e-6 IAA, 1uM ascr#3, 10mM CuSO4, 800mM Sorbitol, OP50) + 2 controls (Control, Fluorescein) x 3 randomized cycles (~15s ON, ~45s CTX buffer = 30 deliveries/worm)
seyedolmohadesin2025.synchrony: simultaneous whole-head volumetric GCaMP6s (~196 sex-shared neurons + 6 male-specific head neurons)
seyedolmohadesin2025.raw_preprocessing_verified: Streamed raw ZephIR `processing/CalciumActivity/ActivityTraces/activity` via HTTP Range (`remfile`); authors' `global_zscored_raw.csv` bandpass/z-score explicitly rejected.

baskoylu2026_copper.citation: Baskoylu, ..., & Flavell (bioRxiv 2026) Parallel neural integrators control distinct features of an aversive behavioral state in C. elegans
baskoylu2026_copper.immobilization: none (freely moving in circular agar arena with 4 mm radius Cu2+ aversive barrier)
baskoylu2026_copper.stimulus_protocol: Causal physical encounters with circular Cu2+ boundary (`dist_from_cuCenter` upward crossing of 38,000 / 0.9*circle_radius)
baskoylu2026_copper.synchrony: simultaneous spinning-disk confocal whole-brain GCaMP7f + NIR behavioral tracking
baskoylu2026_copper.raw_preprocessing_verified: Extracted strictly `gcamp/trace_array_original` (raw un-zscored, unsmoothed fluorescence) + `NeuroPAL_labels.jld2` (`confidence >= 2`); whole-trace z-scored `trace_array` and `F/Fmean` rejected.

toyoshima2024.citation: Toyoshima et al. (PLOS Computational Biology 2024) Ensemble dynamics and information flow deduction from whole-brain imaging data
toyoshima2024.genotype: JN3038 (pan-neuronal nuclear YC2.60 + multi-color landmark reporters)
toyoshima2024.immobilization: PDMS olfactory microfluidic chip (with & without anesthetic, balanced across dev/vault)
toyoshima2024.stimulus_protocol: Periodic microfluidic NaCl step switches (50 mM <-> 25 mM every 30s, period 60s; exact startframe & period per worm from meta/stimulation_timing.xlsx)
toyoshima2024.synchrony: simultaneous 4D spinning-disk confocal whole-head YC2.60 imaging
toyoshima2024.raw_preprocessing_verified: Extracted pure instantaneous raw YC2.60 FRET ratio `YFP / CFP` (`pi_k_Ch3 / pi_k_Ch2`) from `20221118freezed.7z` with zero temporal smoothing and zero full-sequence centering (`normalize1_withoutremove.zip` explicitly rejected).

randi2023_atlas.citation: Randi, Sharma, Dvali & Leifer (Nature 2023) Neural signal propagation atlas of C. elegans
randi2023_atlas.genotype: 113 WT + 18 unc-31(e928) neuropeptide-release mutant (NeuroPAL; GCaMP6s; Chrimson)
